objective: Determine a minimum real pretrained molecule-protein assay and whether released MAP weights can supply defensible named RNA predictions without guessing output order.

fresh_public_checks.status_note: No new author correspondence was sent. Public user reports corroborate missing artifacts but are not independent biological validation.

fresh_checkpoint_metadata.drug_module: pert_model.smiles_encoder plus pert_model.drug_projector; no pert_model.kg_smiles_encoder tensors
fresh_checkpoint_metadata.output_order: No exact 2,000-HVG ordered list was identified in checkpoint metadata, official listing, source tree or inspected replies.

pretrained_shared_space.real_minimum_available_path: Existing authenticated molecule256/knowledge1024 cache + all original gene-projector storages + exact released symbol-indexed ESM vectors for a frozen protein gallery.
pretrained_shared_space.partial_asset_downloads: Original raw ZIP members retained under data/external/map_module_replacement_20261009; no deleted full runtime recreated.
pretrained_shared_space.gallery_definition: All resolvable known menu target genes plus fixed 1000 unambiguous global protein-symbol distractors; target-enriched, not genome-wide.
pretrained_shared_space.shared_space_assay: Cosine retrieval between actual cached knowledge1024 molecules and actual pretrained-projected ESM1024 proteins. Not the full relation-conditioned MAP objective.
pretrained_shared_space.required_compatibility_probe: Strict load both extracted original projectors; reconstruct cached knowledge1024 from cached molecule256 within a fixed 1e-5 tolerance; no learned/random replacement mapping.
pretrained_shared_space.authentication_boundary: Per-member ZIP CRC, source file/revision, byte ranges and local SHA bind the partial subset. The original full-file SHA cannot be verified from selected ranges. Molecule reconstruction establishes represented-cache compatibility, not full checkpoint byte identity.

full_relation_conditioned_minimum.limitation: Cannot replace fine-tuned text weights with a generic BioBERT and claim original relation conditioning. Frozen direct molecule-protein cosine has a narrower valid meaning.
full_relation_conditioned_minimum.biological_boundary: Even original relation-conditioned scores establish encoded graph-content retrieval only; target engagement, signed cellular effect and downstream decision value require distinct evidence.

native_RNA_feasibility.historical_static_tensor_loading: Prior bridge strictly loaded all 499 checkpoint tensors and ran finite forwards, but used current public component semantics with a disclosed older hierarchy adapter.
native_RNA_feasibility.scope: These are measured historical compatible-bridge properties, not an authenticated original PrimeKG_ver1 forward or author-training failure claim.
blockers: Attention mask/readout/position and dropout semantics matched to training
Ordered 2,000-output HVG map and its gene vocabulary
Exact evaluation/drug/KG-exclusion split provenance for a reproduction claim
native_RNA_feasibility.public_preprocess_scale: Inspected current loader uses log1p(1000 * hvg / sum(hvg)) when hvg_not_yet_normed is True. This alone does not certify released old checkpoint target scale.
native_RNA_feasibility.no_guessed_gene_map: The pretrained decoder rows are positional weights; neither current Tahoe gene metadata nor a new HVG selection authenticates their missing training-time order.
native_RNA_feasibility.consequence: Do not produce named-gene RNA comparisons, GSEA or production response replacements from these released outputs until the missing semantic/axis contract is provided.

scope_limitations: No production interfaces or frozen STATE paths modified
All trial scoring requires the frozen protocol and hash-bound assets
